--agent-id.help: Agent config name pre-saved in A.I.G Web UI

--agent_provider.help: Agent provider YAML file (required for dynamic testing)

--aig-mode.help: Enable AIG integration mode: emit structured JSON logs to stdout for the Go backend to parse. Not needed for standalone pip install use (disabled by default).

--choice.help: Technique selection strategy: 'random' (default) or 'serial' (nested techniques) or 'parallel'

--csv.help: 输出 CSV 文件路径

--datasets.help: Dataset names (default: JailBench-Tiny). Options: JailBench-Tiny, JailbreakPrompts-Tiny, ChatGPT-Jailbreak-Prompts, JADE-db-v3.0, HarmfulEvalBenchmark

--eval_api_key.help: API Key for a evaluate model

--eval_base_url.help: Base URL for a evaluate model

--evaluate_model.help: Model name for a evaluate model

--header.help: Custom header in key:value format (can be used multiple times)

--json.help: 输出 JSON 文件路径

--language.help: Output language: zh (Chinese, default) or en (English)

--output.help: Save the scan result as a JSON file (optional, e.g. -o result.json)

--phase0.help: Path to phase0.json from host self-introspection

--plugins.help: Custom plugin files or directories to load

--repo.help: Path to the project directory to scan (optional, for source audit)

--report.help: Path to save the risk assessment report (default: logs/report.md)

--save-history.help: 保存对话历史,将保存为history.jsonl

--scan-tools.help: Scan and display all available tools and their parameters

--server_url.help: Remote MCP server URL (for dynamic scanning)

--show-tool-params.help: Show detailed parameter information for a specific tool

--sim_api_key.help: API Key for a simulator model

--sim_base_url.help: Base URL for a simulator model

--simulator_model.help: Model name for a simulator model

--skills.help: Comma-separated detection skill names to run (e.g. 'web-exfiltration-detection'). If not specified, all default detection skills will be used.

--skip-compromised.help: 跳过已 compromised 的模块

--target.help: 目标URL，可以指定多个目标，例如: --target xx.com --target aa.com

--top-n.help: How many operators to try per goal

--validate-plugin.help: Validate a plugin file or directory

--vuln-dir.help: 漏洞规则目录；默认自动使用 AIG data 或内置数据

--vuln-lang.help: AIG 漏洞规则语言，默认 zh

--wait.help: Wait and poll if still running
